scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONT,BACK "bun run run:react" "bun run run:hono"
scripts.run:fast: cd apps/fast && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.build:front: cd apps/react && bun run build --mode production
scripts.build:server: bun run build:front && bun run build:back && bun scripts/build.ts
scripts.build:fast: cd apps/fast && uv run python -m nuitka --onefile --standalone app/main.py
scripts.build:webapi: cd apps/netwebapi && dotnet publish -c Release --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true
scripts.build:wpf: cd apps/wpf && dotnet publish -c Release --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true
scripts.deploy:server: bun run build:server && bun run deploy
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/hono && bun x drizzle-kit migrate
